title: The "$60 Gaming PC" – AMD BC-250 (2025)
summary: A comprehensive guide on building an ultra-budget gaming PC for $60 using the AMD BC-250 processor, exploring whether it's possible to achieve playable framerates on modern titles with minimal investment in 2025.
problem_solved: Enables gamers on extremely tight budgets to build a functional gaming PC for as little as $60.
why_valuable: Demonstrates that entry into PC gaming doesn't require hundreds of dollars, opening doors for budget-conscious enthusiasts and proving the viability of ultra-low-cost gaming builds.
